name: rust-analyzer
description: Rust language server with a Windows process-tree memory budget and reduced background concurrency

memory_limit_mib.title: Rust memory budget (MiB)
memory_limit_mib.description: Combined committed-memory ceiling for rust-analyzer and its children. Whole MiB; the LSP group stops near 95% of this ceiling.

server.title: rust-analyzer executable
server.description: Executable on PATH, or an absolute .exe path. The rustup proxy respects the workspace toolchain.
